NgraceChangeDesignContext.Rationale:
This is the successor to C-PLANNING-PHASE-TEACHING-1-CBE5DFAD. The normative source of truth is `spec.xml`; nothing here adds a requirement, and every binding obligation is repeated in the spec's acceptance criteria and scope. This document is explanatory: it records the corrected reasoning, the inheritance and provenance, and the reviewed diagrams.
Two defects were repaired in the inherited implementation. First, `ngrace-plan` rule 19 told the planner to drive the full CI in a faithful post-close copy at plan time, while rule 20 reserves the full CI-equivalent verification for close time under the outer `--assertions final --run-commands` gate. The recast keeps what each rule was for: PLAN still proves that its narrow commands and structural assertion probes can run on disposable, complete projects, in the state each task leaves and in a close-shaped copy where the evidence depends on it; the full CI is not a PLAN instrument. EXECUTE owns two distinct CI activities: the executor's single outer selected `--assertions final --run-commands` gate on the active approved bundle, whose full CI-equivalent leaves are `bun run validate:ci`, `bun run validate:cli`, and `bun run release:check`; and authority/Luna's independent rehearsal of the sanctioned apply/archive on a faithful copy, followed by those same three direct commands on the faithfully applied and archived copy. The independent post-close run is not the active outer final gate: an applied copy is not reapproved and no active status is fabricated.
Second, the same rule carried the stale statement that a faithful post-close copy must carry `.ngrace/scratch` read-only or `review.confidently-wrong` fires on archived plan baselines. The review read boundary moved: it discovers active `plan.xml` files and derives the bundle location before opening any plan content (`src/review/core.ts:506-511`), so an unrelated archived plan is opaque history and its `MustExist` buffer path is never evaluated. The claim is recast, not mechanically deleted, because the underlying instruction is still useful: a faithful copy must carry the inputs the selected evidence actually declares — the repository state, the applicable VCS state, and the ignored/untracked inputs the run depends on. What goes away is the named archive-baseline symptom and any temptation to add an archive reader or hard-code this repository's record pipeline into the published skill.
The inherited checker is part of the deliverable. The private `checkStalePlanPhaseClaims` helper (`scripts/check-teaching-surface.ts:649-666`) is wired into the existing public `runTeachingSurfaceCheck`; it recurses through every regular `SKILL.md` under both trees, normalizes whitespace, and refuses the two exact obsolete fragments even when quoted. Two positive needles — "is not run at PLAN" and "necessary ignored/untracked inputs" — sit in the `ngrace-plan` must_do home (`:456-457`). A `SKILL.md` edit moves the measured footprint; the strict numeric pins in `src/test-support/token-accounting.test.ts` and the `README.md` cell equal the measured final canonical totals (the relation is normative, the figure is not).
The predecessor could not close because its approved Guard A derived the archive directory inventory from Git alone, and Git cannot track an empty directory. Independent current execution refused seventeen existing archive `run/` directories. Approved governance is immutable, so the maintainer approved a sanctioned supersede; the CLI folded the predecessor's loose events and archived it without changing code or any earlier archive, adding the eighteenth empty `run/` directory. The corrected contract freezes the Git preservation base at `4d4c837cacc59ba59a44dcb7bf708a3404ab2e3c` and additionally seals the exact measured filesystem-only inventory of eighteen empty `run/` directories. The six product files are inherited working-tree changes; this successor does not re-author them, and the original executor chronology for those edits is not asserted.
The reviewed conceptual diagrams below describe the corrected phase contract and the corrected preservation instrument, not new implementation classes. The sequence diagram shows the retained six-file inherited implementation adopted rather than re-authored, the frozen Git baseline plus the eighteen sealed filesystem-only `run/` directories, the exact own-arrival exception, the carried stage costs, the narrow SPEC/PLAN probes against separate EXECUTE CI activities, and the maintainer ratification with authority-owned gates. The class diagram names the same structure. Every binding behaviour is repeated in the spec's acceptance criteria.

Alternatives.Alternative: Keep the full-CI-at-PLAN sentence and weaken rule 20 instead. Rejected: it would move the whole CI-equivalent verification, and the single outer final gate that owns it, into planning; the increment was introduced against the predecessor's close-time-only criterion, and the original purpose is served by narrow feasibility work plus EXECUTE-final and independent post-close evidence.

Delete the faithful-copy guidance wholesale when its scratch example became obsolete. Rejected: the generic requirement is still load-bearing — a copy missing declared inputs, VCS state, or ignored/untracked inputs produces evidence the selected commands cannot evaluate — so the sentence is recast, not removed.

Add an archive reader or re-introduce archive-aware review teaching so the old scratch claim becomes true again. Rejected: it reopens historical-schema compatibility the current-only policy withdraws, and hard-codes this repository's record pipeline into a published skill.

Re-author the six product files under this successor instead of adopting the inherited implementation. Rejected: a second implementation would duplicate already-delivered work and invent a provenance the facts do not support; the successor's remaining work is the corrected governance contract.

Keep the predecessor's Git-only directory inventory and exclude the empty `run/` directories. Rejected: an exclusion drops the preservation guarantee for those directories, and the sanctioned supersede exists precisely so the corrected contract can measure and seal them.

Project the post-edit footprint figures into the spec now. Rejected: a projected figure expires the moment the edit lands (F272); the spec states the relation and the implementation transcribes the measurement.

DeferredDecisions.Decision: The exact recast sentences are plan/implementation detail already carried by the inherited files. The binding requirements are that rule 19 states PLAN-does-not-run-CI and CI-is-EXECUTE-close-time with a distinct independent post-close activity, that the generic faithful-copy requirement stays, and that the private guard refuses the two exact obsolete fragments even quoted.
Whether the guard is expressed as a token addition and a private stale-claim walk is plan detail; it stays inside the two already-scoped checker files and adds no runtime export or dependency.
The post-change `skillTextLines().total` and `.totalBytes` are measured through the shipped instrument; the measured values are `875` and `89020`, and any later edit re-measures them.

Phase-contract guard scenario on disposable fixtures. A planted `ngrace-plan` SKILL.md that instructs running the full CI at PLAN, or that restores the scratch-cause claim, reddens the private stale-claim guard and names the file — even when the fragment is quoted or whitespace-wrapped. A planted SKILL.md that drops the corrected phase sentence reddens the positive `ngrace-plan` must_do needle and names the missing token. Both directions are driven, and the real canonical and packaged trees pass.

Faithful-copy scenario. A planner assembles a disposable, complete close-shaped copy carrying the selected record's declared inputs/dependencies, applicable VCS state, and necessary ignored/untracked inputs; the narrow verification commands and relevant structural assertion probes evaluate against that copy without running the full CI. The full CI-equivalent verification belongs to EXECUTE and has two distinct activities: the executor's single outer selected `--assertions final --run-commands` gate whose leaves are `bun run validate:ci`, `bun run validate:cli`, and `bun run release:check`; and authority/Luna's independent run of those same three commands on the faithfully applied and archived copy. The independent post-close run is not the active outer final gate: it does not reapprove an applied copy or fabricate active status.

Preservation-instrument scenario (Guard B) on a complete disposable Git fixture. The base is the frozen `4d4c837cacc59ba59a44dcb7bf708a3404ab2e3c`; the six product paths and the exact own active/archive directories are the only allowances. Clean and the six-path/own-close controls pass; an outside tracked ordinary or staged byte change, a staged addition, a deletion, a type/mode change, and a masked (`--assume-unchanged` / `--skip-worktree`) byte change each fail; each mutation is restored and raw restoration equality is checked. The guard reads exit codes directly and fails closed on a missing base or a failed Git or filesystem read, and it never parses archive XML, schema, or content.

Archive-preservation scenario (Guard A) on a complete disposable Git fixture. The guard checks the Git byte/mode/file/root baseline and the fixed measured list of eighteen empty archive `run/` directories: each must exist as a real non-symlink directory with captured mode `0755` and stay empty. It rejects a missing, changed, or extra path, an ignored or untracked addition, and an added or missing root, and it allows exactly the successor's own `.ngrace/changes/archive/C-PLANNING-PHASE-TEACHING-2-10CC89CA` subtree, with the reason that the close's own lawful rename must not redden the criterion it wrote. The predecessor's archive arrival is inside the base and needs no exclusion. The exact sanctioned own-arrival control passes; each mutation is restored and raw restoration equality is checked. The guard retains its `git diff` segment and fails closed on a missing base or a failed Git or filesystem read.

Parity, footprint, and closure scenario. The canonical `skills/ngrace/ngrace-plan/SKILL.md` and its packaged mirror are byte-identical; `skillTextLines()` measures the edited canonical tree, and the strict test pins and the README measurement cell are equal to that measurement. At closure the authority applies the approved plan and the selected bundle's own archive arrival is the only sanctioned archive change; the executor's outer final gate and the authority's independent post-close CI run are separate activities, and the maintainer ratifies the closure.
